# How many slots a ring buys, by frame size and depth.
# Generated - do not edit. To refresh after a change to the rule:
#   cargo test -p lumit-lfx regenerate_ring_slot_table -- --ignored
#
# slots = clamp(floor(RING_BUDGET_BYTES / slot_bytes), RING_MIN_SLOTS, RING_MAX_SLOTS)
# slot_bytes = w x h x 4 x depth_bytes + HEADER_BYTES
# A plugin's declared window asks for hi - lo + 2 and may raise, never lower.
#
# RING_BUDGET_BYTES = 536870912, HEADER_BYTES = 64, slots in [3, 64]

| | fp32 slots | fp16 slots |
|---|---|---|
| 720p | 36 | 64 |
| 1080p | 16 | 32 |
| UHD 4K | 4 | 8 |
| 8K | 3 | 3 |

And what one declared window costs, at UHD 4K:

| window | fp32 slots | fp16 slots |
|---|---|---|
| 0 .. 0 | 4 | 8 |
| -1 .. 1 | 4 | 8 |
| -5 .. 5 | 12 | 12 |
| -32 .. 32 | 64 | 64 |
